about: What the frozen code sprite sprites/bg-battle-dungeon.js drew and answered in every call the tests that read it made, recorded so the code can go (docs/data-sprites.md section 5, R2b/R3). From the frozen copy tests/fixtures/code-sprites/bg-battle-dungeon.js (a word-for-word copy of the library's sprites/bg-battle-dungeon.js as it was before its redraw; the working tree of 2026-11-21 on top of commit abbc3db). Frames: palette indices, little-endian 16-bit, deflated, base64 (palette[0] is "no pixel"); calls: answers of fps(), sockets(), slice() and textArea(), JSON text or null. Keys: first 16 hex digits of the SHA-1 of the call's sorted-key JSON (tests/helpers/code-replay.mjs callKey). Read by tests/helpers/code-replay.mjs replaySprite(id). Recorded by: drift.

def.name: Dungeon battle backdrop
def.blurb: A torch-lit hall for a side-view battle screen in three layers that repeat sideways (a dark wall of arches, pillars with flickering torches, a flagstone floor with the fighters' feet on row 150): scroll far at 0.1, mid at 0.4 and near at 0.7 of the camera's speed. Change the stone, the floor, the torch light, the number of torches and pillars and the height of the arches.
